leads.name: Flatter-Ulme (European White Elm) at the Karpfenteich, Schlosspark Charlottenburg

location.address: Schlosspark Charlottenburg, southeastern corner of the Karpfenteich, Spandauer Damm, Berlin

leads.reason: Officially registered as Naturdenkmal 4-27/B ('Park Schloss Charlottenburg, suedoestliche Ecke Karpfenteich') per the Wikipedia-compiled Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf Naturdenkmal list, but that is a single source with no age, girth or coordinates given. Repeated searches (German and English, SPSG tour pages, local press) found no second source describing this specific tree. White elms are increasingly rare due to Dutch elm disease, which would make an old surviving specimen genuinely notable if its age and a second source can be found. Would sit within a few hundred metres of ber_004 (the Swamp Cypress) if it verifies.

leads.name: Echte Mispel (Medlar) at Schloss Charlottenburg, west wing

location.address: Schloss Charlottenburg, am Westfluegel des Schlosses, Berlin

leads.reason: Naturdenkmal 4-28/B per the official register list, single source, no age or dimensions given. Medlars are small trees (typically under 5m) so remarkability is doubtful on size or age; the case would have to rest on rarity as a once-common, now-forgotten fruit tree plus its royal-garden setting. Needs a second source and a stronger case before it clears the qualifying bar.

leads.name: Kirschpflaume (Cherry Plum) at Schloss Charlottenburg, west wing

location.address: Schloss Charlottenburg, am Westfluegel des Schlosses, Berlin

leads.reason: Naturdenkmal 4-29/B per the official register list, single source, no age. Cherry plum is a common small ornamental/fruit tree; unclear this individual clears 'genuinely old OR visually spectacular OR historically significant' even with a second source. Lower priority than the other Charlottenburg leads.

leads.name: Kaukasische Fluegelnuss (Caucasian Wingnut) at Lietzensee

location.address: Lietzensee, northern part, east shore, near Lietzenseeufer 5, Berlin

leads.reason: Naturdenkmal 4-25/B (neu) per the official register list. A Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf district page describes the species generally (large, multi-stemmed, golden autumn colour, planted in European parks for about 150 years) but gives no age or history for THIS specimen. Visually distinctive species, roughly 1.7km south of Schloss Charlottenburg (within walking distance of ber_004 and the other Charlottenburg leads above). Needs a second, tree-specific source (the Lietzenseepark 'Umweltpfad' info-stele apparently gives an age but its content was not accessible to this pass) and exact coordinates.

leads.name: Platane (Plane tree) at Lietzensee

location.address: Lietzensee, northern part, west shore, near Wundtstrasse 56, Berlin

leads.reason: Naturdenkmal 4-26/B per the official register list. A search-engine summary of monumentaltrees.com's Berlin age-records page mentioned '218-year-old plane trees (Platanus hispanica) in the Lietzenseeparks in Charlottenburg', which would be a strong second source for age if confirmed, but this pass could not fetch monumentaltrees.com directly (HTTP 403 on every attempt) to verify that figure firsthand, read it in context, or confirm it applies to this specific registered tree rather than a different plane in the same park. Needs a direct read of that page (or an alternate route to it) plus exact coordinates before it can verify. Per hard rule 1, monumentaltrees.com may only be used for verification, never copied as the sole source.

leads.name: Trauben-Eiche, Pfaueninsel, ca. 150m nordoestlich vom Schloss (ND 6-108/B)

location.address: Pfaueninsel, north of the Schloss, 14109 Berlin

leads.reason: One of four Naturdenkmal Trauben-Eichen registered on Pfaueninsel; the other three are already published (ber_011 = ND 6-102/B, 'The Great Oak', register coords 52.431453/13.120752 vs our 52.4315/13.1207, about 10m apart; ber_012 the Tuereiche = ND 6-101/B, register coords 52.430667/13.122139 vs our 52.430565/13.122087, about 12m apart; ber_013 = ND 6-103/B, register coords 52.433833/13.134 vs our 52.4338/13.1342, about 15m apart). data/registers/berlin-naturdenkmale.json (CC0-equivalent, DL-DE-Zero 2.0) carries this entry's coordinates directly (register_id 6-108/B): 52.431763, 13.121202, only 45m from ber_011 and 146m from ber_012, well inside the existing Pfaueninsel walk. Register alone is one source; a second, tree-specific, genuinely independent source is still needed. UPDATED 2026-08-07 (second pass, this session): WebFetch and curl to external hosts now work directly for some hosts and via the r.jina.ai reader proxy for others (curl itself needs a bash-approval this session cannot grant, so all fetching went through WebFetch/WebSearch/r.jina.ai). Progress and the remaining gap: (1) The primary source was finally read in full: https://r.jina.ai/https://www.berlin.de/sen/uvk/_assets/natur-gruen/naturschutz/schutzgebiete/aktuelle-verfahren/ndvoe_anl1_201201.pdf (direct WebFetch on the PDF returns unreadable font-encoded streams; the r.jina.ai text-extraction proxy works) returns the actual ordinance entry: register id 6-108/B, species 'Quercus petraea var. laciniata (Lam.) C. Vicioso', German name 'Geschlitzblättrige' Trauben-Eiche (a rare cut-leaf variety), location 150m northeast of the Schloss, designation criterion 2a (Seltenheit/rarity). This CONFIRMS the cut-leaf detail a previous pass could only get as an unverifiable WebSearch snippet. (2) BUT: this ordinance PDF and the imported register JSON are the same underlying government designation (both trace to the Bezirksamt Steglitz-Zehlendorf Naturdenkmalverordnung, digitised into the Land Berlin GIS/WFS layer that the JSON was pulled from), so treating them as two INDEPENDENT sources is not honest, they are one official source read twice. (3) Went looking for a real independent tree-specific source: baumkunde.de register entries 2135 ('Eiche auf der Pfaueninsel', GPS E13°7.2423'/N52°25.889' = 52.43148/13.12074, 'ostrich-shaped twisted crown', 5.67m girth, vital Sep 2015, explicitly states NO cut-leaf/Geschlitzblättrige note) and 6402 ('Tuereiche auf der Pfaueninsel', ~250yr, 5.58m girth, 8.5m height) were fetched directly and both match the coordinates of the ALREADY-PUBLISHED ber_011 (2135, ~2m away) and ber_012 (6402, matches Tuereiche by name) respectively, not 6-108/B (24m+ from 2135's coords). ostdeutsches-baumarchiv.de's 'Traubeneiche 1 auf der Pfaueninsel' (Umfang 565cm, 'Schlosswiese, am Weg zwischen den beiden Wiesenteilen, noerdlicher Bereich', species given inconsistently as both Quercus robur on one page and generic Traubeneiche on its own index page) does not match 6-108/B's 'ca. 150m nordoestlich vom Schloss' location either and is likely yet another tree or a mislabelled duplicate of one of the other three. monumentaltrees.com pages (14327, 28796) are blocked (403) to both direct WebFetch and the r.jina.ai proxy (bot-detection page, not the article). SPSG.de and de.wikipedia.org's Pfaueninsel article both confirm only that the island has 'several-hundred-year-old' free-standing oaks generally and that SPSG/Berlin Botanical Garden run a rare-plant conservation project there, with no tree-specific corroboration of 6-108/B. CALL: still does not clear the two-independent-source bar. Stays a lead. Next pass: try baumkunde.de's own site search (blocked at /Suche/ path with 403 to WebFetch this session, worth retrying with a browser UA via curl if bash approval is available) for an entry matching 52.4318/13.1212 specifically, or contact SPSG's Pfaueninsel-specific tree documentation (Meine Pfaueninsel / blog articles) directly rather than via WebSearch summary.

leads.name: Ahornblaettrige Platane (London Plane), west of the Wirtshaus zur Pfaueninsel (ND 6-71/B)

location.address: Pfaueninselchaussee 100, west of the Wirtshaus zur Pfaueninsel, 14109 Berlin

leads.reason: NEW this pass (2026-08-07), found by re-reading the full berlin-naturdenkmale.json register for all 'Pfaueninsel' entries rather than only the four oaks already known: a fifth Naturdenkmal sits on Pfaueninsel, register id 6-71/B, designated for 'Schoenheit, landeskundliche Gruende' (beauty, regional-historical reasons) rather than rarity or age. Roughly 340m south of ber_011 (The Great Oak), i.e. still on the same ferry-only island and well inside a walkable cluster, though on the opposite (southern, ferry-landing) end near the restaurant rather than by the Schloss. Register is one source. This pass found WebSearch snippets referencing a baumkunde.de entry for a 'Platane am Wirtshaus zur Faehre Pfaueninsel' / 'Gewoehnliche Platane' but could not obtain the actual URL or fetch the page directly (baumkunde.de's /Suche/ search path returns 403 to WebFetch); this is an unconfirmed lead on a second source, not a verified one. Worth a focused look next pass: find the exact baumkunde.de baumregister URL (try browsing baumkunde.de/baumregister/alle/ pages or a Google site: search for the exact slug) and/or SPSG's own Pfaueninsel materials, which manage the Wirtshaus grounds directly and may describe the tree. Also sanity-check whether 'Platanus acerifolia' here should be relabelled 'London Plane' per hard rule 9 (it is the same species as Platanus x hispanica, already the convention on this site). UPDATED 2026-08-08: retried, WebFetch and WebSearch both worked this session (unlike the 2026-08-07 pass, which needed r.jina.ai). site: search on baumkunde.de and direct search-page fetches (baumkunde.de/baumregister/temp/Suche/platane, /Suche/pfaueninsel) surfaced only the same two already-published entries (2135 = ber_011, 6402 = ber_012) and generic Wirtshaus-restaurant pages, nothing for 6-71/B specifically. CALL: still a dead end on a second source. Do not re-hunt Pfaueninsel further without a genuinely new route in (e.g. an actual account reaching SPSG's own archive rather than its public search).
